compatibility.conflict: Ordinary 15:30 uses +.10 EV and #99AFE0 fill. Hero uses +.35 EV referenced to paintover-v1 E0 and neutralized #AEBCCA fill; no renderer equivalence proven. compatibility.resolution: This is an explicitly versioned hero review preset, not a silent rewrite of time-of-day keys. Calibrate E0 and witness patch before adopting in engine. For the shared hero witness use direct .38 / fill .62, hence key:fill .612903. Do not also apply the legacy 2.2 contribution ratio.

phenologyPolicy.tropics: retain evergreen canopy; wet/dry flush and leaf turnover, no universal peak fall

phenologyPolicy.unknown: retain last supported state with stale/unknown label; never label inferred foliage observed

near.construction: opaque smooth clustered crown lobes; visible scaffold/sky holes; palm frond groups not individual leaflets

mid.construction: reduce lobe count, keep silhouette and trunk split

far.construction: one to three opaque masses or area-weighted canopy class; no twigs or individual leaves

detailTiers.transitions: same seed and silhouette bounds; 10% hysteresis proposed; 0.25 s geometric crossfade if renderer can fit it; avoid double alpha overdraw
detailTiers.note: Bible ambient prop thresholds unchanged; these thresholds apply to foliage crown representation

performanceProposal.budgetRelationship: carve out of existing scene budget, never add on top; not benchmarked
performanceProposal.materials: shared palette instances, opaque crowns; no transparent leaf cards by default
performanceProposal.ground: material masks for lawn colour/mowing/litter; no individual grass blades
performanceProposal.far: area-weighted coverage in linear RGB; no uniform region tint
performanceProposal.thermal: reduce far foliage detail and shadows before changing tree dimensions
